name: Power Snatch
description: The power snatch is a variation of the Olympic snatch in which the bar is received above parallel — the athlete catches the bar in a partial squat rather than a full overhead squat. The higher catch position requires greater bar height and more explosive power than the full snatch, making it an effective power development tool and a useful teaching progression. It is widely used in sport conditioning, CrossFit, and as an Olympic lifting warm-up.

execution.starting_position: Same as the full snatch — bar over mid-foot, wide snatch grip, flat back, hips between shoulders and knees.
execution.setup_instructions: Use bumper plates. The power snatch requires the same setup and pulling mechanics as the full snatch — the distinction is in the catch height.
steps: Step 1: Set the starting position with a wide snatch grip.
Step 2: First pull — push the floor away and keep the bar close to the body.
Step 3: Second pull — extend the hips explosively as the bar passes the hip crease, using maximum power.
Step 4: Shrug and pull the elbows high and outside to generate maximal bar elevation.
Step 5: Catch the bar overhead with elbows locked in a squat above parallel (thighs above horizontal), then stand fully.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace before initiating. Hold through the pull. Exhale after securing the overhead catch.
common_mistakes: Catching too deep (this becomes a full snatch — above parallel is the power snatch standard)
Relaxing the bar path and letting it drift forward
safety_considerations: Use bumper plates and be prepared to bail the bar safely forward.
Master bar mechanics with lighter loads before increasing weight.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Catch must occur above parallel. The overhead catch must have locked elbows and stable shoulder position.
execution.tempo_recommendations: Explosive. Maximum bar speed is the objective. No tempo prescription.
coaching_cues: Pull the bar as high as possible before turning over
Catch above parallel — not in a full squat
Punch the hands up and lock the elbows fast
